text: Come get your comb.
scene_context: Desert ride, Lo tells Jen to come get her comb.

text: Hurry back to your mother.
scene_context: After Jen is flung off her horse, Lo tells her to hurry back to her mother.

text: Don't touch the women!
scene_context: Attack on caravan: Lo orders bandits not to touch women.

text: You've got quite a temper. It's better this way.
scene_context: Cave: Lo speaks to tied-up Jen after she chokes on water

text: Still in a bad mood? At least you're speaking. What's your name?
scene_context: Cave: Lo speaks to Jen after she calls him a coward

text: I didn't think the Hans had names like that.
scene_context: Cave: Lo speaks to Jen after she spits at him

text: When I was a boy, one night, I saw a thousand shooting stars. I thought, where did they all go? I'm an orphan. I used to look for stars alone. I thought if I rode to the other end of the desert, I'd find them. I've been riding in the desert ever since.
scene_context: In the bath, Lo speaks to Jen about his childhood as an orphan and his search for stars.

text: I don't take orders from anyone.
scene_context: Confrontation with Jen over orders

text: Your father's men are still looking for you. They're still out there, circling closer.
scene_context: Crest of cliff: Lo and Jen see uniformed men; Lo discusses father's men searching for Jen.

text: It is trouble for me.
scene_context: Crest of cliff: Lo and Jen see uniformed men; Lo states the trouble for him.

text: Out here, you always fight for survival. You have to be part of a gang to stand a chance. Slowly, your gang becomes your family. All that Dark Cloud stuff is just to scare people and make my life easier.
scene_context: Speaking with Jen about survival, gangs, and Dark Cloud

text: I am a man. And now I've found the brightest star of all.
scene_context: Speaking with Jen about being a man and finding the brightest star

text: No more hitting on the head! All this trouble for a comb?
scene_context: In a scene where Lo is removing cactus needles from Jen's feet, discussing a comb.

text: Not true. I can use it to pick fleas from my horse.
scene_context: In a scene where Lo is removing cactus needles from Jen's feet, discussing a comb.

text: I'm sorry... I guessed wrong. I though you were a Han.
scene_context: In a scene where Lo is removing cactus needles from Jen's feet, discussing a comb.

text: She's mine.
scene_context: Sand scene: Lo claims Jen as her own to the bandits.

text: She's mine.
scene_context: After Lo tells his story to Yu and Li.

text: I don't care anymore.
scene_context: After Lo tells his story to Yu and Li.

text: All right.
scene_context: After Lo tells his story to Yu and Li.

text: A faithful heart makes wishes come true.
scene_context: Bridge: Jen asks about the legend of the young man, Lo responds with the saying.

text: To be back in the desert, together again.
scene_context: Bridge: Jen prompts Lo to make a wish, Lo states his wish.

text: I will.
scene_context: Jen asks Lo to return the jade comb; Lo agrees.

text: Jen!
scene_context: Jen's room: Lo sneaks in through the window and calls Jen's name.

text: With all the traffic on your rooftop these days... it took me a while to get in here. I can't wait any longer. I was wrong to let you go. Come back with me. You'll be happy in the desert. You'll be free there.
scene_context: Jen's room: Lo pleads with Jen to return to the desert.

text: Jen! Come with me! You're mine!
scene_context: Outside carriage, Lo calls to Jen inside.

text: Come with me to the desert! Jen!
scene_context: In the crowd, Lo calls to Jen about the desert.

text: Come with me to Xin Jiang!
scene_context: In the crowd, Lo calls to Jen about Xin Jiang.

text: Let's stop a moment.
scene_context: Riding, Lo suggests stopping to rest.

text: You're tired. You need rest. Your horse needs water. There's a creek up here.
scene_context: Riding, Lo explains the need for rest and points to a creek.

text: Well, there used to be! What's your name? I'm Lo. The Hans call me Dark Cloud. I'm not that tall or big, but I'm quick as lightning.
scene_context: At a dry creek bed, Lo speaks to Jen about the creek.

text: Jen...
scene_context: After Jen whispers 'Go' to Lo

text: You're eating too fast. Slowly.
scene_context: Jen is wolfing down food; Lo tells her to slow down.

text: Relax. If I had wanted to, I would already have done it. You must be dying for a bath. Fresh water's hard to get here. But I managed to bring some up. You can wear my clothes when you're done. They're clean. Don't worry. I'll sing, so you'll know where I am.
scene_context: In a makeshift bathroom, Lo speaks to Jen after untying her, offering a bath and explaining the water situation.

text:
Your father's men are looking for
you.
scene_context: Lo uses binoculars to inform Jen that her father's men are looking for her.
